sentences.text: Al vaciar el viejo escritorio de su abuela, Clara encontró un sobre amarillento.
sentences.translation: While emptying her grandmother's old desk, Clara found a yellowed envelope.

sentences.text: La tinta se había desvanecido, pero aún podía leerse un nombre desconocido.
sentences.translation: The ink had faded, but an unknown name could still be read.

sentences.text: Intrigada, desdobló con cuidado el papel quebradizo.
sentences.translation: Intrigued, she carefully unfolded the brittle paper.

sentences.text: La carta hablaba de un amor que nunca llegó a confesarse.
sentences.translation: The letter spoke of a love that was never confessed.

sentences.text: Clara comprendió que su abuela había guardado aquel secreto durante décadas.
sentences.translation: Clara realized that her grandmother had kept that secret for decades.

sentences.text: Por un momento, dudó entre destruirla o conservarla.
sentences.translation: For a moment, she hesitated between destroying it or keeping it.

sentences.text: Sin embargo, sintió que tenía el deber de honrar aquella memoria.
sentences.translation: Nevertheless, she felt she had a duty to honour that memory.

sentences.text: Decidió guardar la carta en un lugar seguro, como un pequeño tesoro.
sentences.translation: She decided to keep the letter in a safe place, like a small treasure.

sentences.text: Desde entonces, miró el retrato de su abuela con otros ojos.
sentences.translation: From then on, she looked at her grandmother's portrait with different eyes.

sentences.text: Algunas historias, pensó, sobreviven al silencio.
sentences.translation: Some stories, she thought, outlive silence.

questions.question: Where did Clara find the letter?
What did Clara finally decide to do?

sentences.text: Desde joven, Tomás había soñado con crear su propia empresa.
sentences.translation: From a young age, Tomás had dreamed of creating his own company.

sentences.text: Muchos le advirtieron de que el riesgo era considerable.
sentences.translation: Many warned him that the risk was considerable.

sentences.text: Aun así, decidió invertir todos sus ahorros en el proyecto.
sentences.translation: Even so, he decided to invest all his savings in the project.

sentences.text: Los primeros meses fueron agotadores y llenos de incertidumbre.
sentences.translation: The first months were exhausting and full of uncertainty.

sentences.text: En más de una ocasión estuvo a punto de rendirse.
sentences.translation: On more than one occasion he was about to give up.

sentences.text: No obstante, su perseverancia acabó dando frutos.
sentences.translation: Nevertheless, his perseverance eventually paid off.

sentences.text: Poco a poco, el negocio empezó a ganar clientes y reconocimiento.
sentences.translation: Little by little, the business began to gain clients and recognition.

sentences.text: Tomás aprendió que el éxito rara vez llega sin sacrificio.
sentences.translation: Tomás learned that success rarely comes without sacrifice.

sentences.text: Hoy dirige un equipo que comparte su misma visión.
sentences.translation: Today he leads a team that shares his same vision.
